customer_message.subject: Owner wants our family flat for his son – after our complaint
customer_message.body:
Name: Samuel Castellano
Address: Hinterfeld 112, 3612 Steffisburg, 4.5 rooms
Landlord: Liegenschaften Sternen AG

Message:
I live here with my wife and our daughter; this is our family home.

On Monday the owner told my wife on the phone that his son wants to move into our flat and that the lease will be ended at the end of January. We have not received any termination in writing, neither a letter nor a form.

The timing is suspicious. In August we demanded, through the tenants' association, that the long-promised repair of the bathroom be done and that the rent be reduced until then. Two weeks later the owner suddenly needs our flat for his son.

I would like to know how we should prepare and whether we can do anything before the written termination arrives.

Samuel Castellano
